messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync 0min: found three small but related docs/snippet issues affecting onboarding: TS default import in quickstart, JS examples missing CJS variant, and Python env var name mismatch. Customers + SEs tripping on copy/paste.

Diego Alvarez: Oof. Can you list the exact failures?

Maya Chen: TS snippet currently shows:
```ts
import Redwood from 'redwood-inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
```
This blows up in strict ESM/TS projects with no `esModuleInterop`: `TypeError: Redwood is not a constructor`. Our package exposes a named factory.

Sofia Kim: And Python?

Maya Chen: Python README uses REDWOOD_API_TOKEN in examples but our SDK reads REDWOOD_API_KEY. New users get 401s and the error message didn't help them find the typo.

Diego Alvarez: Also we've seen people paste the JS snippet into both modern ESM demos and older Node CJS demos and it fails in one of the two.

Maya Chen: Proposed fixes: 1) Update TS example to use the named import: `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference'` + show usage. 2) Add both JS variants so copy/paste works:
```js
// CommonJS
const { createClient } = require('redwood-inference');
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });

// ESM / TS
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference';
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
```
3) Fix Python snippets to use REDWOOD_API_KEY and `create_client(...)` which wires recommended retry/backoff. 4) Add a short Troubleshooting FAQ entry that points to the right env var and explains `esModuleInterop` vs named exports. 5) Add tiny smoke checks in docs CI: pack the SDK and run minimal CJS/ESM/py quickstart runs to catch copy/paste regressions.

Sofia Kim: Love the smoke CI idea. Will catch these before SEs demo. Can you also add a one-line onboarding checklist item for Solutions Eng?

Maya Chen: Yep 0min I'll open a single PR containing README updates, FAQ entry, CI smoke script, and a note for the onboarding checklist. Will include test that asserts 401 message suggests REDWOOD_API_KEY when token is wrong.

doc-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1203 "quickstart snippets: import/export parity, CJS/ESM examples, and env var parity"

ci-bot: CI started for docs/pr-1251  lint + smoke tests kicked off.

Diego Alvarez: Thanks Maya 50min. If you want, I can add a tiny line in the SDK changelog linking to the FAQ so integrators see the change in import/export contract.

Maya Chen: Good call. I'll add a changelog note. PR opened and CI currently running. I'll ping when merged.

ci-bot: docs/pr-1251 smoke test failed  the ESM smoke run failed due to sample build path; retrying after fix.

Maya Chen: Fixed tsconfig outDir issue in the sample-app; rerunning.

ci-bot: docs/pr-1251 all checks passed  ready to merge.

Sofia Kim: :shipit: Thanks for moving fast on this. SE onboarding checklist updated after merge.
